selection_note: Target-village portfolio for evidence deepening. Inclusion is not a site ranking, project selection, authorization, commitment, or bankability statement.

semantics.target: Portfolio inclusion means evidence deepening only; it is not ranking or site selection.
semantics.depth: Approach and anchorage depths are not berth depths. Null depth means not verified.
semantics.load: Null load limits mean not verified. Runway length or water depth alone never establishes cargo capacity.
semantics.seasonality: Published/general service windows are planning context and remain weather/ice/operator dependent.
semantics.coordinates: Village coordinates are approximate community references, not facility coordinates.
semantics.energy_projects: External energy projects are source-backed context only. Study, funded, active, rejected and operating statuses remain distinct; null geometry never becomes a synthetic route.
